name: I keep Dying in Another World -What the hell, Goddess!-
source:
In this Kinetic Novel, follow John as he tries to [b]stop a murder[/b] from happening. He will keep [b]returning after death[/b] to continue with newfound knowledge, alliances, and ideas to fulfill the mission Goddess summoned him for. [b]As many times as it takes[/b].

There are clues scattered on the way. Can YOU unravel the mystery before John does?
What [b]secrets[/b] is the Goddess hiding? Will she be a [b]help or a hindrance[/b]? Uncover the [b]conspiracy[/b] behind the murder.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713990/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这本动感小说中，跟随约翰尝试[b]阻止谋杀[/b]从发生。他会保留[b]死后返回[/b]继续利用新发现的知识、联盟和想法来完成女神召唤他的使命。[b]需要多少次都可以[/b]。

路上散落着一些线索。你能在约翰之前解开这个谜团吗？
什么[b]秘密[/b]女神躲起来了吗？她会成为一个[b]帮助或阻碍[/b]？揭开[b]阴谋[/b]谋杀案的背后。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713990/]蒸汽[/url]]
